description: The test frameworks whose cases the editors show (mcpp design 2026-10-30 part 2 §7.2). A test program belongs to a framework when its plan holds one of the framework's packages and its source calls one of the framework's macros. `name` says how a case's full name is made from the macro's arguments; `list` lists the cases (run only for a program whose source calls a macro); `filter` selects cases, `{}` being the cases joined by `join`, each with the characters of `escape` preceded by a backslash (a GoogleTest name is two identifiers, which hold none of its filter's special characters); `report` writes the results to the file `{}`, read as `reportFormat`. boost-ext.ut is not here: its runner takes no filter from the command line, so its tests run as programs.
